proves.claim: offerPulledLanding with parallelGates on starts no git child process while its board write lock is held

cli.io-landing-pull.git-outside-offer-lo.why: Without it every offer held the board write lock for 30 s or more while git ran under it, stalling every other board writer.

proves.claim: the offered job carries the same items, files, tests and flakes as when the reads ran inside the lock, and an item a concurrent offer took is still left out

cli.io-landing-pull.offer-unchanged-outs.why: Without it moving the git reads out of the lock could change which items a landing offers or what each job carries.
